description.text: Near-total darkness fills a bare concrete service bay, its depth swallowed by black except for a faint, cool reflection along a damp patch on the floor. The ceiling is low, its beams barely distinguishable overhead, and the walls recede into soft, featureless shadow. A shallow puddle spreads near the center of the floor, its surface trembling with each small vibration. At the center distance, a
is little more than an unreadable silhouette, its edges merging with the gloom. The air feels still and enclosed; no people, signage, or loose equipment are visible. As the

begins to move, a newly generated low engine rumble enters softly, more felt than heard, and the silhouette starts to separate from the background. The vehicle rolls forward at a measured pace, its tires whispering over the concrete, and a thin sheen of light catches the leading edge of its hood. The shape advances toward the foreground, gradually becoming legible: the broad front bodywork, the horizontal line of the grille, the rounded corners of the bumper, and the dark mass of the cabin behind them. No badges, lettering, or plate details are readable. The headlamps remain subdued, so the

is defined mainly by the growing contrast between its moving body and the surrounding black. The floor reflection stretches and breaks beneath the tires, while the distant work lamp remains a small, steady point far behind the
. By the middle of the shot, the

occupies more of the frame, its front end clear enough to read as a solid object rather than a shadow. It continues forward without hurry, holding a straight path, and the sound of the engine settles into a steady low-frequency hum. The darkness recedes behind it but does not vanish entirely; the background stays deep and uninformative, keeping attention on the emerging vehicle. Near the end, the
has pulled close enough that its hood and grille are plainly visible, while the cabin and rear remain partially lost to shadow. The rumble softens slightly as the forward motion eases, leaving the
present and readable against the black, with the damp concrete and the single distant lamp still framing the space.
